verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence states that Crossmint itself absorbs dispute risk and manages chargebacks directly with the bank on the user's behalf (crossmint-supp-10), which is for the general Checkout product, not agent-specific. There is no documentation of any developer-facing API for submitting dispute evidence, checking dispute status, or retrieving outcomes. Missing for 10: any dispute-management API endpoints, evidence-submission workflow, or status/outcome reporting for agent transactions.
